identityRules: Library selection/Preview is not an accepted plan. capture() reads acceptedPlan and weekState, never selected row display text.

A collection record contains canonical saved-week-v1 only. Its Open restores the exact accepted origin/inputs/calendar/arrangement, then accepts a fresh empty worksheet; it does not silently persist or recover venue notes.

An applied caregiver handoff restores its exact original accepted origin plus complete validated matching notes, including empty replacement, occurrence/date identity, omitted visits and prior question history.
A collection Rename/Remove changes local storage metadata/rows. The already opened plan is a detached accepted snapshot and remains unchanged, as the released UI explicitly promises.
Equal display names do not establish identity. Original origin, canonical source and occurrence/date bindings remain with unchanged native codecs/models.
Exports are generated on the explicit gesture from the current accepted origin/state/model. There is no cached combined export and no automatic provider request.
